# Golf Data Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into a golf-data interface for PGA Tour, LPGA, and DP World Tour via a bundled CLI (`sports-skills`) on ESPN public endpoints — zero config, no API keys: current tournament leaderboards, hole-by-hole scorecards, full season schedules, golfer profiles and season overviews (stats, rankings, recent results), and tour news. It comes with golf-aware guardrails: tournaments not games, scores relative to par, one event per week per tour, and explicit lists of commands that don't exist (no betting odds, no FedEx Cup standings). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it runs on unofficial ESPN public endpoints — they work today but can change or break without notice; the CLI needs `pip install sports-skills` (Python 3.10+); player IDs must come from leaderboard results or ESPN URLs, never guessed. skills.sh Trust Hub: unverified. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
